strings.timelineHint: On by default. Connected appointments are added, updated and removed after deletion or lesson confirmation. Turning this off removes this app’s pins. Your reminders stay active. If the Pebble app asks, allow timeline access and then reopen the watch app.
strings.timelineWaiting: Waiting for current appointments from the watch.
strings.timelineSubmitted: Appointments sent to the Pebble app. It syncs the timeline with your watch.
strings.timelineUnsupported: This Pebble app does not support local timeline pins yet. Please update the Pebble app.
strings.timelineRetry: The timeline could not be fully updated yet. It will retry at the next connection.
strings.timelineSaveError: Could not save the timeline setting. Please try again.
strings.heading: Your driving lessons.
strings.intro: Plan on your phone or directly on your watch. Appointments stay saved on the watch.
strings.languageHint: The watch confirms when the language has been saved.
strings.zoneHint: Phone local time. Your phone and watch should use the same time zone.
strings.topicHint: Theory checkmarks count as one core or class-specific unit. An assigned lesson does not count an already checked topic again.
strings.footer: Appointments and progress stay on your watch.
strings.offline: No live connection. Open the watch app and connect Bluetooth. These settings refresh automatically while connected.
strings.alarmError: A system alarm could not be scheduled. Please check the watch.
strings.storageError: Watch storage error. Please restart the watch app.
strings.deleteConfirm: Delete this appointment and its reminders?
strings.busy: A transfer is pending. Please wait for confirmation on the watch.
strings.needSync: No current watch data. Open the watch app and connect Bluetooth; data refreshes automatically.
strings.invalidDate: Choose a valid future date and time. A daylight saving change can make a time invalid.
strings.sameReminder: Choose different reminders or turn off reminder 2.
strings.invalidPractice: Enter 45 to 540 minutes in steps of 5.
strings.tagline: Your driving lessons at a glance
strings.packNeeded: Internet and watch connection needed for the first download
strings.settingsOnly: Phone settings language saved. The watch language stays unchanged.
strings.settingsError: Could not load the language pack. The previous language stays active. Reopen settings to retry.
strings.settingsReady: Phone settings language saved · available offline
strings.settingsFallback: English offline fallback. For the first language pack, connect to the Internet and reopen settings.
